laws.name: Hawaii Family Leave Law (HFLL)
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for eligible employees to care for a family member with a serious health condition or for bonding with a new child.

laws.name: Hawaii Temporary Disability Insurance (TDI)
laws.description: Provides partial wage replacement for employees unable to work due to a non-work-related illness or injury, including pregnancy-related conditions.

laws.name: Hawaii Victims Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic or sexual violence to seek medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or safety-related services.
